_comment: GameLife tuning file. Every number and formula parameter lives here (brief section 4). Restart the backend after editing. Fields starting with _ are comments.

todo._comment: Base XP = xpPerMinute x expected minutes. No upper limit on minutes (brief 6).

timer._comment: Base XP = xpPerMinute x counted minutes. Counted minutes never exceed planned length.

home._comment: Daily XP goal drawn as the 'today' bar on the home screen (brief 6: about 100 XP on a normal day).

character._comment: Balanced title (brief 8): every stat at least balancedMinLevel and highest minus lowest at most balancedMaxGap. Rank names live in content/character.json.

streak._comment: multiplier = 1 + factor x streakDays ^ exponent (no cap).

fight._comment: The losable boss fight (brief 9.1). Boss k: HP = bossBaseHp x bossHpGrowth^(k-1), ATK per day = bossBaseAtk + bossAtkPerBoss x (k-1). After each ascension bosses are stronger: x (1 + ascensionBossScale x ascensions). Hero max HP = heroBaseHp + heroHpPerVitalityLevel x Vitality level + armour. Shield of a day = min(1, that day's XP / home.dailyXpGoal). A fully shielded day heals fullShieldHeal. defeatMode: mild | medium | hard.

weapon._comment: Damage multiplier = bonusPerLevel ^ level. Cost of level n -> n+1 = baseCost x costGrowth ^ n. Resets to 0 on ascension.

armor._comment: Each level: +hpPerLevel max HP and +reductionPerLevel damage reduction (capped at maxReduction). Cost of level n -> n+1 = baseCost x costGrowth ^ n. Kept on ascension.

ascension._comment: XP multiplier = perAscension ^ number of ASCEND events (New Game+ after the last boss file is beaten).

shop._comment: Charms equipped at once, and how many past days the shop uses to predict days-to-beat.

statLevels._comment: XP from level L to L+1 = base x growth ^ (L - 1). Every stat starts at level 1.

loot._comment: Chance that a validation also drops a cosmetic item you do not own yet. Cosmetic only, never coins or XP.
